text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score over all leads of each blend minus the best single member of its technology (smaller is better). Grey line: same as the best member. Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months, 98.33% for the lead-band blend and 99.17% for the others. Primary demand: 73 runs, one every 5 days, seed 0. Solar and wind: 53 Tuesday runs, three seeds. July 2025 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: Quantile score over all leads of each blend minus the best single member of its
technology (smaller is better). Grey line: same as the best member. Dot:
estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months, 98.33% for the lead-band
blend and 99.17% for the others. Primary demand: 73 runs, one every 5 days, seed
0. Solar and wind: 53 Tuesday runs, three seeds. July 2025 to June 2026.
